paite: TOUPA muangte tuh Zion tang hihlin vual louh, tangtawn a om gige ding bang ahi.
heading: Pathian Mite Bitna
english: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

paite: Tangte, Jerusalem kim a a-om bang in amite kim ah TOUPA a-om hi. Tu a kipan tangtawn in.
english: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

paite: Gilou-salou lalchiang midiktat tan tung ah akinga kei ding a; midiktatte'n akhut ua thulimlouhna akhoih kei uleh.
english: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

paite: TOUPA aw, hoihtak a omte tung ah hoihtak in hih in, alungtang ua diktak a omte tung ah.
english: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

paite: Alampi kawi ua pialte bel TOUPA'N thil hihkhialte toh apikhe ding. Israelte tung ah khamuanna om hen.
english: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
